items.situation: student asking where the pool schedule is posted
items.speaker: Where's the pool schedule usually posted?

options.A: It's on the board by the desk.
options.B: The pool is heated all winter.
options.C: I got a quick walk in after lunch.
options.D: It costs thirty dollars a semester.

items.explanation: 说话人问的是课表张贴的位置，A 直接给出位置「前台旁边的公告板」，是最自然的答复。B 抓住「pool」改说泳池水温，属语义联想陷阱，没有回答地点。C 是一句在别的对话里成立的闲聊，与本题完全无关。D 回答的是价格，答非所问（问 where 却答 how much）。

items.situation: student checking how the weekend shuttle schedule works
items.speaker: How does the weekend shuttle work? I've never taken it.

options.A: I nearly missed the shuttle this morning.
options.B: Your guess is as good as mine.
options.C: The stop is behind the science building.
options.D: She left her umbrella on the seat.

items.explanation: B 是习语「Your guess is as good as mine」，意思是「我也不清楚」，用地道口语承认自己同样不知道，是最自然的答复。A 重复「shuttle」但讲的是今早差点错过班车的往事，属语义联想陷阱。C 回答的是站点位置，问的却是周末班次怎么排，答非所问。D 与本对话毫无关联，只是一句语法正确的普通句子。

items.situation: two friends deciding where to get lunch
items.speaker: Don't you want to try the new deli?

options.A: The deli hired two more cooks.
options.B: Yes, I finished the reading last night.
options.C: Actually, I brought something from home.
options.D: It's right across from the gym.

items.explanation: C 以话语标记「Actually」开头，不直接说「不去」，而是说明自己带了饭，属于间接婉拒，是最自然的答复。A 抓住「deli」转而陈述餐厅招人，属语义联想陷阱。B 虽以 Yes 开头，但接的是读书作业，跟午饭毫无关系，是离题项。D 回答的是餐厅位置，而对方问的是要不要去，属答非所问。

items.situation: friend inviting another to a study session
items.speaker: Aren't you coming to the study session tonight?

options.A: The session covers chapters four and five.
options.B: I left my jacket in the car.
options.C: In the basement of the union building.
options.D: Can we make it a bit later?

items.explanation: D 用反问推进对话，提出把时间往后挪，既回应了邀约又给出可行方案，是最自然的答复。A 重复「session」但转去描述复习范围，属语义联想陷阱。B 是一句放在别的对话里才成立的话，与邀约无关。C 回答的是地点，而对方问的是来不来，属答非所问。

items.situation: student telling a professor about missing office hours
items.speaker: I've been missing you during office hours.

options.A: Let's find a time that works.
options.B: Office hours are listed on the syllabus.
options.C: My car wouldn't start again this morning.
options.D: I missed the bus twice this week.

items.explanation: 说话人在陈述自己的困难，作为被倾诉的一方，教授用「Let's find a time that works」提出一起另约时间，是最自然的解决式答复。B 只是把答疑时间指回教学大纲，回避了对方已经错过的事实，属语义联想陷阱。C 讲自己的车打不着火，与本对话无关。D 把「miss」误读成「错过交通工具」，属一词多义误解陷阱。

items.situation: student asking a librarian why a journal cannot leave the room
items.speaker: Why can't I take this journal out of the room?

options.A: The reading room closes at nine.
options.B: Well, it's the only copy we have.
options.C: I ordered a coffee before coming in.
options.D: On the second floor, near the stairs.

items.explanation: B 以话语标记「Well」开头，说明馆里只有这一本，间接解释了为何不外借，是最自然的答复。A 重复「reading room」却讲闭馆时间，属语义联想陷阱。C 与本对话毫无关联。D 回答的是位置，而对方问的是原因，属答非所问。

items.situation: student unsure what the final exam covers
items.speaker: I've got no idea what the final covers.

options.A: The final is worth forty percent.
options.B: My cousin is visiting this weekend.
options.C: Did you check the review sheet?
options.D: Yes, it's in the main auditorium.

items.explanation: C 用反问把对话推向解决办法，提示对方去看复习提纲，是最自然的答复。A 重复「final」但讲的是分数占比，没有回应对方的困惑，属语义联想陷阱。B 与本对话无关。D 答的是考场地点，且对一句陈述句用「Yes」回应也不合适，属答非所问。

items.situation: checking when the post office closes
items.speaker: What time does the post office close today?

options.A: I mailed the package last Tuesday.
options.B: It's two blocks past the pharmacy.
options.C: My phone battery died on the way.
options.D: Just so you know, they close early Fridays.

items.explanation: D 以话语标记「Just so you know」开头，间接提醒对方周五提前打烊，实质上解决了对方的时间顾虑，是最自然的答复。A 重复「mail/package」这一联想语境却讲上周寄件，属语义联想陷阱。B 回答的是位置，而对方问的是时间，属答非所问。C 与本对话无关。

items.situation: student seeking help booking a tutor at the writing center
items.speaker: How do I book a tutor appointment?

options.A: Sure thing, let me walk you through it.
options.B: The tutors are all graduate students.
options.C: My appointment with the dentist is Thursday.
options.D: Yes, the center is on the third floor.

items.explanation: A 用口语套话「Sure thing」应下来并表示带对方走一遍流程，是写作中心工作人员最自然的答复。B 抓住「tutor」转去介绍辅导员身份，属语义联想陷阱。C 借「appointment」讲牙医预约，属一词多义误解陷阱。D 答的是楼层位置，而对方问的是怎么预约，属答非所问。

items.situation: two classmates reacting to a group project deadline moving up
items.speaker: Why did the deadline move up? I'm not ready.

options.A: The project counts for half our grade.
options.B: I moved into a new apartment last week.
options.C: Don't worry, I'll finish my part tonight.
options.D: Next Monday at five in the afternoon.

items.explanation: C 不去解释原因，而是直接安抚对方并承诺今晚做完自己那部分，解决了对方真正担心的问题，属典型的 context_shift。A 重复「project」却讲分数权重，属语义联想陷阱。B 把「move」误读成「搬家」，属一词多义误解陷阱。D 答的是截止时间点，而对方问的是原因，属答非所问。
